confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Kyoto price levels, rolled forward to July 2026 for inflation and exchange-rate drift; no live listings checked. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderate confidence; accommodation is least certain given July peak demand, event-driven rate swings and unclear lodging-tax treatment. Cocktail and wine anchors are inferred from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX figure is from a search summary attributed to the RBA overview page (not opened directly); latest found is 13 Oct 2026, with no 14 or 15 Oct figure located.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to general Japanese price levels, using Osaka and Tokyo as broad reference points for food and drink and Kyoto's own tourism-driven accommodation market for lodging.
